All six changes applied. The clang diagnostics are spurious (C vs C++ detection artifacts, not real errors).

**Summary of changes:**
- `PaymentGateway::charge` — declaration and definition updated with `descriptor` parameter (`payment_gateway.h`, `payment_gateway.cpp`)
- `PaymentService::authorize` — declaration and definition updated, forwarding `descriptor` to `gateway_.charge` (`payment_service.h`, `payment_service.cpp`)
- `OrderService::submit` — call site passes `"user_checkout"` (`order_service.cpp:16`)
- `AdminOrderService::submit` — call site passes `"admin_bulk"` (`admin_order_service.cpp:18`)
- `BillingGateway::charge` and `PaymentService::refund` left unchanged.
